## Requirement Status Model

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Evidenced | Supported by accepted or historical project sources; still requires confirmation for the new platform where the implementation changes. |
| Proposed | Included in the new web-app plan or current direction, but not yet stakeholder-approved. |
| Unresolved | A decision, stakeholder input, or technical evidence is required before prioritization or commitment. |
| Deferred | Explicitly excluded from the proposed MVP and available for later review. |

## Requirement Analysis

### Launch-Critical Candidate Set

RQ-01 through RQ-11 protect the original replacement outcome, participant access, content availability, and production safety. RQ-01 and RQ-09 still need an authentication and membership decision. RQ-10 and RQ-11 are proposed technical controls that must be confirmed against the selected server environment.

### Proposed Product Enhancements

RQ-12 through RQ-16 create the Skool-inspired community experience. Current evidence comes from the proposed delivery plan, not from a participant or stakeholder validation record. PM-12 should not include them as committed launch scope until the requester and LeadLab Director confirm their value for the September program.

### Unresolved Requirements

RQ-17 and RQ-18 require explicit decisions. RQ-17 concerns residual video URL-sharing risk. RQ-18 concerns whether the historical Microsoft 365 SSO requirement remains valid after the platform change.

## Traceability Rules for PM-12 and PM-13

Each approved requirement should link to:

- A committed scope item or explicit exclusion.
- A backlog item or work package.
- An acceptance test.
- A responsible owner or approver.
- Any related risk, assumption, dependency, or decision.

## Stakeholder Validation Needed

| Stakeholder | Questions to confirm |
|---|---|
| Requester / PM | Which requirements are committed for September, and who owns scope decisions? |
| IT team | Which server runtime, database, storage, authentication, backup, and monitoring capabilities are available? |
| Media team | Which sessions, video links, categories, dates, and materials must be live, and by when? |
| LeadLab participants | Can users find, watch, search, filter, and download content on their devices? |
| LeadLab Director | Are community, classroom, calendar, moderation, and role features required for launch? |

## Quality Conclusion

The draft contains source, rationale, priority, status, and testable outcomes for the candidate requirements. It separates historical replacement requirements from proposed product enhancements and unresolved decisions. It does not approve any requirement or establish the scope baseline.
